2611.17881.title: Photogrammetric 3D Model-Based Animal Behavior Classification
2611.17881.paper_summary: Video-based behavior estimation is often implemented end-to-end from image sequences. We advocate a two-stage alternative: reconstruct 3D body and object geometry before classifying behavior. This makes ambiguities of the ill-posed 2D-to-3D inverse problem explicit and potentially correctable. We demonstrate the strategy with simulated interacting mice and extend it to real video.
2611.17881.author: Olaf Hellwich et.al.
2611.17881.authors: Olaf Hellwich, Moritz Heine, Patrik Reiske, Sole Traverso, Katharina Hohlbaum, Henning Sprekeler, Christa Thöne-Reineke, Lars Lewejohann, Roman Bhuiyan
